investor_type.quote: Od roku 2008 táto investičná spoločnosť pomohla rozbehnúť viacero úspešných spin-off projektov (Colosseo, StreamStar) či start-upov (už spomínané Piano Media, Diagnose.me) alebo Websupport.

sectors.quote: Monogram Ventures je zameraná na hi-tech produkty a komercializáciu nových digitálnych trendov.

investments.quote: In July 2011 it raised €300,000 from MONOGRAM Ventures, Etarget and NextBig.

notes: Likely inactive: monogram.sk is now an unrelated lifestyle blog and monogramventures.com is a parked domain; newest deal found is the 2011 Piano Media seed. Its partner Ivan Štefunko later co-founded Neulogy Ventures (c009), but no source states that Monogram Ventures became Neulogy, so it is not marked as a duplicate.
